crossRefs.note: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you…
But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from…
Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we…
Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through…
comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

translations.web: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
translations.bsb: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!
translations.kjv: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish
translations.asv: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
